plugins.name: Create from Access Database
plugins.description:
## Create from Access Database

Imports a **Document Model** from a Microsoft Access database (`.accdb` / `.mdb`).

### Features

- **Automatic field mapping** – column types are mapped to Document Model field types automatically
- **Table selection** – choose which table to import from a dropdown list
- **Preview** – see a flat list of fields before confirming the import
- **No ODBC required** – uses the pure-Java [Jackcess](https://jackcess.sourceforge.io/) library, so no native drivers or DSN configuration is needed

### How it works

1. Open the **File → New** menu and select *Create from Access Database*
2. Pick an `.accdb` or `.mdb` file
3. Select the source table from the list
4. Confirm – the Document Model is created immediately

### Supported field types

| Access type | Document Model type |
|-------------|--------------------|
| Text / Memo | `STRING` |
| Number / Currency | `DECIMAL` |
| Date/Time | `DATE` |
| Yes/No | `BOOLEAN` |

> **Note:** Linked tables and password-protected databases are not supported in this version.

![Plugin overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/syd711/a12-studio/main/docs/images/plugin-access-overview.png)

plugins.name: Create from Excel
plugins.description:
## Create from Excel

Imports a **Document Model** from a Microsoft Excel workbook (`.xlsx` / `.xls`).

### Features

- **Header detection** – column headers in the first row automatically become field names
- **Type inference** – cell types are sampled to infer the appropriate Document Model field type
- **Preview** – a flat field list is shown before the import is confirmed
- **Wide format support** – reads both modern `.xlsx` and legacy `.xls` formats via [Apache POI](https://poi.apache.org/)

### How it works

1. Open the **File → New** menu and select *Create from Excel*
2. Choose an `.xlsx` or `.xls` file
3. Review the detected fields in the preview list
4. Enter a name and confirm – the Document Model is created immediately

### Field type mapping

| Excel cell type | Document Model type |
|-----------------|--------------------|
| String | `STRING` |
| Numeric | `DECIMAL` |
| Boolean | `BOOLEAN` |
| Date / Time | `DATE` |
| Formula result | inferred from value |

> **Tip:** Make sure your first row contains descriptive column headers – they are used directly as field names in the generated model.

![Plugin overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/syd711/a12-studio/main/docs/images/plugin-excel-overview.png)
